description: Align irregular alternative data with price data using point-in-time discipline, normalize and handle missing values, and evaluate information content via correlation diagnostics.
agent_prompt: Merge alternative data with price data using point-in-time discipline. Inputs: /workspace/data/AAPL_2018_2024.csv (daily OHLCV) and /workspace/data/sentiment_data.csv (irregular timestamps with sentiment_score column). Build a merge pipeline in /workspace/src/ that: (1) aligns sentiment to AAPL daily index with explicit lag (e.g. T+1 to avoid look-ahead from intraday-published sentiment); (2) handles missing sentiment days by forward-fill within a configurable max_ffill_days then leaving NaN beyond; (3) normalizes sentiment to z-score using only past data (rolling 90d mean/std); (4) verifies the merged dataset has no future leakage (assert sentiment value at date T was published <= T-1 close). Produce outputs at /workspace/output/: merged.csv (date, AAPL_open, AAPL_close, AAPL_return_t1, sentiment_raw, sentiment_zscore_pit), leakage_check.json (passed: bool, evidence: list of timestamp-pair examples), info_content.json (correlation between sentiment_zscore_pit and forward-1d AAPL return, including p-value and bootstrap CI), and merge_diagnostics.json (n_aapl_days, n_sentiment_days, n_merged, n_ffilled, n_dropped).

required_capabilities: Align irregular alternative data with price data using explicit lag
Apply point-in-time discipline to prevent look-ahead leakage
Normalize alternative data using only past values
Test information content with correlation and significance
